title: Trade Site and Currency Exchange Guide
summary: How to use the Path of Exile 2 trade site (pathofexile.com/trade2) and the Currency Exchange: premium stash tabs, pricing with poe.ninja, buying with whisper commands, and avoiding common trading mistakes.
description: A practical guide to trading in Path of Exile 2: the trade site, Currency Exchange, premium tabs, price checking, and safe buying and selling.
imageAlt: Jeweller's Orbs, a currency used for trading and socket changes in Path of Exile 2
prerequisites: A character in the game (any point past the early campaign)
Access to the Path of Exile trade website
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

items.title: Where do I trade?
body: The official trade site is pathofexile.com/trade2. It hosts item search and the Currency Exchange, where you convert currencies (for example Chaos to Exalted, or Divine to Chaos) in bulk.

items.title: How do I sell?
body: You need a Premium stash tab set to public. Right-click an item in it to set a price; the game gives you a trade command you can paste in chat. Buyers whisper you, then meet in your hideout.

items.title: How do I price fairly?
body: Use poe.ninja as a live price reference for both items and currencies, then undercut slightly to sell faster. The in-game advanced price check helps you value an item before listing.

sections.title: Buying, selling, exchanging
sections.intro: Trading has three distinct flows. Open the one you need.

tabs.label: Buying
paragraphs: Search the trade site, then use the in-game whisper.
bullets: Filter by item type, modifiers, and price on pathofexile.com/trade2.
Click 'Whisper' to copy the command, paste it into game chat, and wait for the invite.
Meet in the seller's hideout and complete the trade in the window.

tabs.label: Selling
paragraphs: List from a public Premium stash tab.
bullets: Set the tab to public and price each item (right-click in the tab).
The game produces a trade command; buyers whisper you with it.
Invite them to your hideout and trade through the window.

bullets: Open the Currency Exchange tab on pathofexile.com/trade2.
Pick the currencies and amounts; the rate updates from live listings.

rules.title: You are likely overpriced
steps: Check poe.ninja and undercut the nearest similar listings.
Confirm the item is in a public Premium tab, not a normal tab.
Re-price and wait; very specific rolls sell slower.

rules.title: Use a public Premium tab
steps: A normal stash tab cannot be listed - convert or buy a Premium tab and set it public.
Right-click items inside it to set individual prices.
Share the tab link from the trade site so others can find your items.

rules.title: Verify against poe.ninja
steps: Currency and item values shift daily; always confirm on poe.ninja before trading.
Use the in-game advanced price check to value an item before listing.
Beware outdated guides quoting old prices.

rules.title: Trade safely
steps: Only trade through the in-game trade window - never 'gift' items outside it.
Confirm the exact currency amount matches before accepting.
If a trade feels off, cancel and re-list.

defaultResult.title: General trading setup
steps: Get a public Premium tab, price items with poe.ninja as reference, and use trade2 to buy.
Use the Currency Exchange to convert currencies in bulk.
Always trade through the in-game window.

items.question: Do I need a Premium stash tab to trade?
answer: To sell, yes - a public Premium tab is required so the trade site can index your items. To buy, you only need the trade site and the in-game whisper.

items.question: What is the Currency Exchange for?
answer: It converts currencies in bulk directly on the trade site, using live rates. It is the fastest way to turn many small orbs into the specific currency you need for crafting.

items.question: How do I know a fair price?
answer: poe.ninja shows live values for items and currencies. Under Cut slightly to sell faster, and use the in-game price check to value an item before listing.
